title: Open Laboratory common definitions
description: Shared definitions referenced by every v1 contract. Not a document type in its own right.

slug.description: Lower-case identifier. Segments of [a-z0-9] joined by '.', '_' or '-'.

semver.description: Semantic version MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with optional pre-release suffix.

schema_version_v1.description: Version of the contract the document was written against. Must be within major version 1.

timestamp.description: UTC wall-clock time, RFC 3339 with a literal 'Z' suffix.

relative_path.description: Forward-slash path relative to a documented root. Absolute paths, drive letters, backslashes and '..' segments are rejected.

permissions.description: Narrowly scoped permissions. Every field defaults to the most restrictive value; network access is off unless explicitly granted.

filesystem.description: Access to the experiment workspace. Nothing outside the workspace is ever grantable.

network.description: 'loopback' permits only host-local model/tool services. 'allowlist' requires network_allowlist.

subprocess.description: Whether child processes may be spawned inside the sandbox.

models.description: Model ids that may be called through the model gateway.

resource_limits.description: Upper bounds enforced by the runtime supervisor, never by the agent.

extensions.description: Free-form area for experimental fields. Consumers must ignore keys they do not understand. Promote a field to the schema proper with a minor version bump.
